title: Artists with several genres
statementMd:
List artists who released albums in at least two different genres.

Expected columns: `name`, `genres`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT ar.name, COUNT(DISTINCT al.genre) AS genres FROM artists ar JOIN albums al ON al.artist_id = ar.id GROUP BY ar.id, ar.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT al.genre) >= 2;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
